skills.name: appotapay-suite
skills.description: Install-all entry skill. Bundles and routes to every AppotaPay skill at once (router, auth, and all 12 product areas).

skills.name: appotapay
skills.description: Router for the AppotaPay platform. Credentials, base URLs per product, signature families, live-docs mechanism, and routing to every sub-skill.

skills.name: appotapay-auth
skills.description: Build the AppotaPay X-APPOTAPAY-AUTH HS256 JWT and compute or verify all five request/callback signature schemes.

skills.name: appotapay-payment
skills.description: AppotaPay hosted checkout: create payment, verify IPN/redirect, status, list, refund, installment IPN, delete card token.

skills.name: appotapay-merchant-hosted
skills.description: Domestic card/bank-account payments collected on your own page (merchant-hosted).

skills.name: appotapay-credit-card
skills.description: International credit cards: tokenize, 3DS enrollment and validation, authorize, capture, reverse, refund.

skills.name: appotapay-ewallet
skills.description: AppotaPay e-wallet OAuth2 linking and wallet/APoint payment, confirm, cancel, unlink.

skills.name: appotapay-subscription
skills.description: Recurring billing: customers, payment methods, plans, cycles, refunds, and callbacks.

skills.name: appotapay-virtual-account
skills.description: Bank-transfer collection through AppotaPay virtual accounts (thu hộ / ebill) and its IPN.

skills.name: appotapay-firm-banking
skills.description: Interbank transfer out: beneficiary lookup, transfer, status, pending-result callback.

skills.name: appotapay-bill
skills.description: Utility bill payment: check bill info, pay, transaction status.

skills.name: appotapay-mobile-topup
skills.description: Mobile airtime and data topup, product codes, subscriber info, transaction status.

skills.name: appotapay-buy-card
skills.description: Buy prepaid card codes (thẻ game, thẻ điện thoại) and check transaction status.

skills.name: appotapay-charging-card
skills.description: Scratch-card redemption (gạch thẻ) with its own SHA-256 signature and AES-128 code encryption.

skills.name: appotapay-pos
skills.description: POS/QR terminal payments on the AppotaPay POS gateway, with the X-Signature header scheme.
